Name: G'raha Tia - FFXIV - (Elliott Replacement)
Author: snomlet
Description:
This mod replaces Elliott with G'raha from FFXIV!
Elliott's schedule and heart event triggers are the same, consult the Wiki for those details.

[u]Changes to gift preferences:[/u]
Added favorite gifts include Fish Taco, Ice Cream, and Survival Burger.
Previously favorite gifts that have become liked gifts include Pomegranate and Lobster.
Everything else should be unchanged.


The biggest changes are dialogue and sprites, so please enjoy!

[i]Mod by @snomlet / @crystallinekitties on tumblr. If you have bug concerns or dialogue weirdness, let me know there!
[/i]I would also love to hear feedback and just vibes, so use #grahasdvmod and/or tag me on tumblr so I can see and go [i]ahee ahoo teehee [/i]:)
